groups.name: conditional-entropy

groups.name: fresh-bad-update

groups.name: fresh-bad-probability
groups.spokenClause: For two logits, class one probability is one divided by the quantity one plus the exponential of class zero logit minus class one logit

groups.name: fresh-fixed-update
groups.spokenClause: Now SGD gives the original negative class-zero and positive class-one rows

groups.name: fresh-fixed-probability
